079/**

084public class DefaultUserManager implements UserManager {

086    private static final String USERDATABASE_PACKAGE = "org.apache.wiki.auth.user";
087    public static final String SESSION_MESSAGES = "profile";
088    private static final String PARAM_EMAIL = "email";
089    private static final String PARAM_FULLNAME = "fullname";
090    private static final String PARAM_PASSWORD = "password";
091    private static final String PARAM_LOGINNAME = "loginname";
092    private static final String UNKNOWN_CLASS = "<unknown>";

094    /** Property with the number of hours between two passes of {@link AccountLifecycle} over the accounts. */
095    static final String PROP_LIFECYCLE_HOURS = "jspwiki.credentials.lifecycle.hours";
096
097    private static final int DEFAULT_LIFECYCLE_HOURS = 24;

109    /**
110     * A lock used to ensure thread safety when accessing shared resources.
111     * This lock provides more flexibility and capabilities than the intrinsic locking mechanism,
112     * such as the ability to attempt to acquire a lock with a timeout, or to interrupt a thread
113     * waiting to acquire a lock.
114     *
115     * @see java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock
116     */
117    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
118
119    /** {@inheritDoc} */
120    @Override
121    public void initialize( final Engine engine, final Properties props ) {
122        m_engine = engine;
123
124        // Attach the PageManager as a listener
125        // TODO: it would be better if we did this in PageManager directly
126        addWikiEventListener( engine.getManager( PageManager.class ) );
127
128        //TODO: Replace with custom annotations. See JSPWIKI-566
129        WikiAjaxDispatcherServlet.registerServlet( JSON_USERS, new JSONUserModule(this), new AllPermission(null));
130
131        // What happens to the accounts as their passwords get older, if the wiki is set up for it
132        final AccountLifecycle lifecycle = new AccountLifecycle( props, this::getUserDatabase, new AccountLifecycleMailer( engine ) );
133        if( lifecycle.isEnabled() ) {
134            final int hours = Math.max( 1, TextUtil.getIntegerProperty( props, PROP_LIFECYCLE_HOURS, DEFAULT_LIFECYCLE_HOURS ) );
135            new AccountLifecycleThread( engine, lifecycle, hours * 3600 ).start();
136        }
137    }

139    /** {@inheritDoc} */
140    @Override
141    public UserDatabase getUserDatabase() {
142        return Synchronizer.synchronize( lock, () -> {
143            if( m_database != null ) {
144                return m_database;
145            }
146
147            String dbClassName = UNKNOWN_CLASS;
148
149            try {
150                dbClassName = TextUtil.getRequiredProperty( m_engine.getWikiProperties(), PROP_DATABASE );
151
152                LOG.info( "Attempting to load user database class {}", dbClassName );
153                m_database = ClassUtil.buildInstance( USERDATABASE_PACKAGE, dbClassName );
154                m_database.initialize( m_engine, m_engine.getWikiProperties() );
155                LOG.info( "UserDatabase initialized." );
156            } catch( final NoSuchElementException | NoRequiredPropertyException e ) {
157                LOG.error( "You have not set the '{}'. You need to do this if you want to enable user management by JSPWiki.", PROP_DATABASE, e );
158            } catch( final ReflectiveOperationException e ) {
159                LOG.error( "UserDatabase {} cannot be instantiated", dbClassName, e );
160            } catch( final WikiSecurityException e ) {
161                LOG.error( "Exception initializing user database: {}", e.getMessage(), e );
162            } finally {
163                if( m_database == null ) {
164                    LOG.info( "I could not create a database object you specified (or didn't specify), so I am falling back to a default." );
165                    m_database = new DummyUserDatabase();
166                }
167            }
168
169            return m_database;
170        } );
171    }
172
173    /** {@inheritDoc} */
174    @Override
175    public UserProfile getUserProfile( final Session session ) {
176        // Look up cached user profile
177        UserProfile profile = m_profiles.get( session );
178        boolean newProfile = profile == null;
179        Principal user = null;
180
181        // If user is authenticated, figure out if this is an existing profile
182        if ( session.isAuthenticated() ) {
183            user = session.getUserPrincipal();
184            try {
185                profile = getUserDatabase().findByWikiName( user.getName());
186                newProfile = false;
187            } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) { 
188                LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
189            }
190        }
191
192        if ( newProfile ) {
193            profile = getUserDatabase().newProfile();
194            if ( user != null ) {
195                profile.setLoginName( user.getName() );
196            } else {
197                LOG.warn("new profile however the user principal is null. this shouldn't happen");
198            }
199            if ( !profile.isNew() ) {
200                throw new IllegalStateException( "New profile should be marked 'new'. Check your UserProfile implementation." );
201            }
202        }
203
204        // Stash the profile for next time
205        m_profiles.put( session, profile );
206        return profile;
207    }
208
209    /** {@inheritDoc} */
210    @Override
211    public void setUserProfile( final Context context, final UserProfile profile ) throws DuplicateUserException, WikiException {
212        final Session session = context.getWikiSession();
213        // Verify user is allowed to save profile!
214        final Permission p = new WikiPermission( m_engine.getApplicationName(), WikiPermission.EDIT_PROFILE_ACTION );
215        if ( !m_engine.getManager( AuthorizationManager.class ).checkPermission( session, p ) ) {
216            throw new WikiSecurityException( "You are not allowed to save wiki profiles." );
217        }
218
219        // Check if profile is new, and see if container allows creation
220        final boolean newProfile = profile.isNew();
221
222        // Check if another user profile already has the fullname or loginname
223        final UserProfile oldProfile = getUserProfile( session );
224        final boolean nameChanged = ( oldProfile != null && oldProfile.getFullname() != null ) &&
225                                    !( oldProfile.getFullname().equals( profile.getFullname() ) &&
226                                    oldProfile.getLoginName().equals( profile.getLoginName() ) );
227        UserProfile otherProfile;
228        try {
229            otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByLoginName( profile.getLoginName() );
230            if( otherProfile != null && !otherProfile.equals( oldProfile ) ) {
231                throw new DuplicateUserException( "security.error.login.taken", profile.getLoginName() );
232            }
233        } catch (final NoSuchPrincipalException e) {
234            LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
235        }
236        try {
237            otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByFullName( profile.getFullname() );
238            if( otherProfile != null && !otherProfile.equals( oldProfile ) ) {
239                throw new DuplicateUserException( "security.error.fullname.taken", profile.getFullname() );
240            }
241        } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) {
242            LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
243        }
244
245        // For new accounts, create approval workflow for user profile save.
246        if( newProfile && oldProfile != null && oldProfile.isNew() ) {
247            startUserProfileCreationWorkflow( context, profile );
248
249            // If the profile doesn't need approval, then just log the user in
250
251            try {
252                final AuthenticationManager mgr = m_engine.getManager( AuthenticationManager.class );
253                if( !mgr.isContainerAuthenticated() ) {
254                    mgr.login( session, null, profile.getLoginName(), profile.getPassword() );
255                }
256            } catch( final WikiException e ) {
257                throw new WikiSecurityException( e.getMessage(), e );
258            }
259
260            // Alert all listeners that the profile changed...
261            // ...this will cause credentials to be reloaded in the wiki session
262            fireEvent( WikiSecurityEvent.PROFILE_SAVE, session, profile );
263        } else { // For existing accounts, just save the profile
264            // If login name changed, rename it first
265            if( nameChanged && !oldProfile.getLoginName().equals( profile.getLoginName() ) ) {
266                getUserDatabase().rename( oldProfile.getLoginName(), profile.getLoginName() );
267            }
268
269            // Now, save the profile (userdatabase will take care of timestamps for us)
270            getUserDatabase().save( profile );
271
272            if( nameChanged ) {
273                // Fire an event if the login name or full name changed
274                final UserProfile[] profiles = new UserProfile[] { oldProfile, profile };
275                fireEvent( WikiSecurityEvent.PROFILE_NAME_CHANGED, session, profiles );
276            } else {
277                // Fire an event that says we have new a new profile (new principals)
278                fireEvent( WikiSecurityEvent.PROFILE_SAVE, session, profile );
279            }
280        }
281        m_profiles.put( session, profile );
282    }
283
284    /** {@inheritDoc} */
285    @Override
286    public void startUserProfileCreationWorkflow( final Context context, final UserProfile profile ) throws WikiException {
287        final WorkflowBuilder builder = WorkflowBuilder.getBuilder( m_engine );
288        final Principal submitter = context.getWikiSession().getUserPrincipal();
289        final Step completionTask = m_engine.getManager( TasksManager.class ).buildSaveUserProfileTask( context.getWikiSession().getLocale() );
290
291        // Add user profile attribute as Facts for the approver (if required)
292        final boolean hasEmail = profile.getEmail() != null;
293        final Fact[] facts = new Fact[ hasEmail ? 4 : 3 ];
294        facts[ 0 ] = new Fact( WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_FACT_PREFS_FULL_NAME, profile.getFullname() );
295        facts[ 1 ] = new Fact( WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_FACT_PREFS_LOGIN_NAME, profile.getLoginName() );
296        facts[ 2 ] = new Fact( WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_FACT_SUBMITTER, submitter.getName() );
297        if ( hasEmail ) {
298            facts[ 3 ] = new Fact( WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_FACT_PREFS_EMAIL, profile.getEmail() );
299        }
300        final Workflow workflow = builder.buildApprovalWorkflow( submitter,
301                                                                 WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_APPROVER,
302                                                                 null,
303                                                                 WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_DECISION_MESSAGE_KEY,
304                                                                 facts,
305                                                                 completionTask,
306                                                                 null );
307
308        workflow.setAttribute( WorkflowManager.WF_UP_CREATE_SAVE_ATTR_SAVED_PROFILE, profile );
309        workflow.start( context );
310
311        final boolean approvalRequired = workflow.getCurrentStep() instanceof Decision;
312
313        // If the profile requires approval, redirect user to message page
314        if ( approvalRequired ) {
315            throw new DecisionRequiredException( "This profile must be approved before it becomes active" );
316        }
317    }

319    /** {@inheritDoc} */
320    @Override
321    public UserProfile parseProfile( final Context context ) {
322        // Retrieve the user's profile (may have been previously cached)
323        final UserProfile profile = getUserProfile( context.getWikiSession() );
324        final HttpServletRequest request = context.getHttpRequest();
325
326        // Extract values from request stream (cleanse whitespace as needed)
327        String loginName = request.getParameter( PARAM_LOGINNAME );
328        String password = request.getParameter( PARAM_PASSWORD );
329        String fullname = request.getParameter( PARAM_FULLNAME );
330        String email = request.getParameter( PARAM_EMAIL );
331        loginName = StringUtils.trim( loginName );
332        password = InputValidator.isBlank( password ) ? null : password;
333        fullname = StringUtils.trim( fullname );
334        email = StringUtils.trim( email );
335
336        // A special case if we have container authentication: if authenticated, login name is always taken from container
337        if ( m_engine.getManager( AuthenticationManager.class ).isContainerAuthenticated() && context.getWikiSession().isAuthenticated() ) {
338            loginName = context.getWikiSession().getLoginPrincipal().getName();
339        }
340
341        // Set the profile fields!
342        profile.setLoginName( loginName );
343        profile.setEmail( email );
344        profile.setFullname( fullname );
345        profile.setPassword( password );
346        return profile;
347    }
348
349    /** {@inheritDoc} */
350    @Override
351    public void validateProfile( final Context context, final UserProfile profile ) {
352        final Session session = context.getWikiSession();
353        final InputValidator validator = new InputValidator( SESSION_MESSAGES, context );
354        final ResourceBundle rb = Preferences.getBundle( context, InternationalizationManager.CORE_BUNDLE );
355
356        //  Query the SpamFilter first
357        final FilterManager fm = m_engine.getManager( FilterManager.class );
358        final List< PageFilter > ls = fm.getFilterList();
359        for( final PageFilter pf : ls ) {
360            if( pf instanceof SpamFilter ) {
361                if( !( ( SpamFilter )pf ).isValidUserProfile( context, profile ) ) {
362                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, "Invalid userprofile" );
363                    return;
364                }
365                break;
366            }
367        }
368
369        // If container-managed auth and user not logged in, throw an error
370        if ( m_engine.getManager( AuthenticationManager.class ).isContainerAuthenticated()
371             && !context.getWikiSession().isAuthenticated() ) {
372            session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, rb.getString("security.error.createprofilebeforelogin") );
373        }
374
375        validator.validateNotNull( profile.getLoginName(), rb.getString("security.user.loginname") );
376        validator.validateNotNull( profile.getFullname(), rb.getString("security.user.fullname") );
377        validator.validate( profile.getEmail(), rb.getString("security.user.email"), InputValidator.EMAIL );
378
379        if( !m_engine.getManager( AuthenticationManager.class ).isContainerAuthenticated() ) {
380            // passwords must match and can't be null
381            
382            //this is the new password
383            final String newpassword = profile.getPassword();
384            if( newpassword == null ) {
385                session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, rb.getString( "security.error.blankpassword" ) );
386            } else {
387                final HttpServletRequest request = context.getHttpRequest();
388                //the existing password
389                final String existingPassword = ( request == null ) ? null : request.getParameter( "password0" );
390                //the new password confirmation
391                final String passwordConfirmation = ( request == null ) ? null : request.getParameter( "password2" );
392                if (!newpassword.equals(passwordConfirmation)) {
393                    //password confirmation does not match
394                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, rb.getString( "security.error.passwordnomatch" ) );
395                }
396                if( !profile.isNew() && (existingPassword==null || existingPassword.equals( newpassword ) ) ) {
397                    //existing account and the existing password matches the new password
398                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, "existing password matches the proposed new one" );
399                }
400                if( !profile.isNew() && !getUserDatabase().validatePassword( profile.getLoginName(), existingPassword ) ) {
401                    //existing account and the provided password does not match what we currently have
402                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, rb.getString( "security.error.passwordnomatch" ) );
403                }
404                List<String> msg = PasswordComplexityVerifier.validate(passwordConfirmation, existingPassword, context);
405                for (String s : msg) {
406                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, s );
407                }
408                int reuseCount = Integer.parseInt(m_engine.getWikiProperties().getProperty("jspwiki.credentials.reuseCount", "-1"));
409                if (reuseCount > 0) {
410                    //if it's set to 0 or less, we don't store it so we can skip this check
411                    if (!m_database.validatePasswordReuse(profile.getLoginName(), passwordConfirmation)) {
412                        //password reuse detected
413                        session.addMessage(SESSION_MESSAGES,
414                                MessageFormat.format(rb.getString("security.error.passwordReuseError"), reuseCount));
415                    }
416                }
417            }
418        }
419
420        UserProfile otherProfile;
421        final String fullName = profile.getFullname();
422        final String loginName = profile.getLoginName();
423        final String wikiName = profile.getWikiName();
424        final String email = profile.getEmail();
425
426        
427        if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(m_engine.getWikiProperties().getProperty(Engine.PROP_USE_2_X_ACL_LOGIC, "false"))) {
428            // It's illegal to use as a full name someone else's login name
429            try {
430                otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByFullName(fullName );
431                if( otherProfile != null && !profile.equals( otherProfile ) && !fullName.equals( otherProfile.getFullname() ) ) {
432                    final Object[] args = { fullName };
433                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, MessageFormat.format( rb.getString( "security.error.illegalfullname" ), args ) );
434                }
435            } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) {
436                LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
437                /* It's clean */ 
438            }
439
440            // It's illegal to use as a login name someone else's full name
441            try {
442                otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByLoginName(loginName );
443                if( otherProfile != null && !profile.equals( otherProfile ) && !loginName.equals( otherProfile.getLoginName() ) ) {
444                    final Object[] args = { loginName };
445                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, MessageFormat.format( rb.getString( "security.error.illegalloginname" ), args ) );
446                }
447            } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) { 
448                LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
449                /* It's clean */ 
450            }
451        } else {
452            //JSPWIKI-130, v3+ behavior
453            // It is legal to use as a full name someone else's login name
454
455            // It's illegal to use as a login name someone else's full name
456            try {
457                otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByLoginName(loginName );
458                if( otherProfile != null && !profile.equals( otherProfile ) && !loginName.equals( otherProfile.getLoginName() ) ) {
459                    final Object[] args = { loginName };
460                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, MessageFormat.format( 
461                            rb.getString( "security.error.illegalloginname" ), args ) );
462                }
463            } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) { 
464                LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
465                /* It's clean */ 
466            }
467            //it's illegal to use a username, email or wiki name as a group name
468            try {
469                Group[] groups = m_engine.getManager(GroupManager.class).getGroupDatabase().groups();
470                for (Group grp : groups) {
471                    if (grp.getName().equals(loginName)) {
472                        final Object[] args = {loginName};
473                        session.addMessage(SESSION_MESSAGES,
474                                MessageFormat.format(rb.getString("security.error.illegalloginname"), args));
475                    }
476                    if (grp.getName().equals(wikiName)) {
477                        final Object[] args = {wikiName};
478                        session.addMessage(SESSION_MESSAGES,
479                                MessageFormat.format(rb.getString("security.error.illegalloginname"), args));
480                    }
481                    if (grp.getName().equals(email)) {
482                        final Object[] args = {email};
483                        session.addMessage(SESSION_MESSAGES,
484                                MessageFormat.format(rb.getString("security.error.illegalloginname"), args));
485                    }
486                }
487            } catch (WikiSecurityException ex) {
488                session.addMessage(SESSION_MESSAGES,
489                        "Processing failed. see log for details.");
490                LOG.error("failed to query for groups", ex);
491            }
492            //wiki names must be unique as well.
493            try {
494                otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByWikiName(wikiName );
495                if( otherProfile != null && !profile.equals( otherProfile ) && !loginName.equals( otherProfile.getLoginName() ) ) {
496                    final Object[] args = { loginName };
497                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, MessageFormat.format( rb.getString( "security.error.illegalloginname" ), args ) );
498                }
499            } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) { 
500                LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
501                /* It's clean */ 
502            }
503        }
504        
505
506        // It's illegal to use multiple accounts with the same email
507        if (email != null && email.trim().length() > 0) {
508            try {
509                otherProfile = getUserDatabase().findByEmail( email );
510                if( otherProfile != null && !profile.getUid().equals( otherProfile.getUid() ) // Issue JSPWIKI-1042
511                        && !profile.equals( otherProfile ) && StringUtils.lowerCase( email )
512                        .equals( StringUtils.lowerCase( otherProfile.getEmail() ) ) ) {
513                    final Object[] args = { email };
514                    session.addMessage( SESSION_MESSAGES, MessageFormat.format( rb.getString( "security.error.email.taken" ), args ) );
515                }
516            } catch( final NoSuchPrincipalException e ) { 
517                LOG.debug(e.getMessage(), e);
518                /* It's clean */ 
519            }
520        }
521    }

555    /**
556     *  Implements the JSON API for usermanager.
557     *  <p>
558     *  Even though this gets serialized whenever container shuts down/restarts, this gets reinstalled to the session when JSPWiki starts.
559     *  This means that it's not actually necessary to save anything.
560     */
561    public static final class JSONUserModule implements WikiAjaxServlet {
562
563        private final DefaultUserManager m_manager;
564
565        /**
566         *  Create a new JSONUserModule.
567         *  @param mgr Manager
568         */
569        public JSONUserModule( final DefaultUserManager mgr )
570        {
571            m_manager = mgr;
572        }
573
574        @Override
575        public String getServletMapping() {
576            return JSON_USERS;
577        }
578
579        @Override
580        public void service( final HttpServletRequest req, final HttpServletResponse resp, final String actionName, final List<String> params) throws ServletException, IOException {
581            try {
582                if( params.isEmpty() ) {
583                    return;
584                }
585                resp.setContentType("application/json");
586                final String uid = params.get(0);
587                LOG.debug("uid="+uid);
588                if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(uid)) {
589                    final UserProfile prof = getUserInfo(uid);
590                    //clone the object
591                    ObjectMapper om = new ObjectMapper();
592                    ObjectNode node = om.convertValue(prof, ObjectNode.class);
593                    node.remove("password");
594                    node.remove("previousHashedCredentials");
595                    resp.getWriter().write(node.toString());
596                }
597            } catch (final NoSuchPrincipalException e) {
598                    throw new ServletException(e);
599            }
600        }
601
602        /**
603         *  Directly returns the UserProfile object attached to an uid.
604         *
605         *  @param uid The user id (e.g. WikiName)
606         *  @return A UserProfile object
607         *  @throws NoSuchPrincipalException If such a name does not exist.
608         */
609        public UserProfile getUserInfo( final String uid ) throws NoSuchPrincipalException {
610            if( m_manager != null ) {
611                return m_manager.getUserDatabase().findByUid( uid );
612            }
613
614            throw new IllegalStateException( "The manager is offline." );
615        }
616    }
